findings.title: `unsubscribe` crashes when no `TopicUser` row exists and bypasses `TopicUser.change`
findings.body:
`TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])` returns `nil` if the user does not yet have a `TopicUser` row for the topic (for example, if they received an email sent before this change, or visit `/t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe` for a topic they have not visited). Line 107 then raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'notification_level' for nil:NilClass`.

In addition, mutating the record with `tu.save!` instead of calling `TopicUser.change(current_user.id, params[:topic_id], notification_level: ...)` fails to set `notifications_changed_at` and `notifications_reason_id = TopicUser.notification_reasons[:user_changed]` (and skips publishing the change to `MessageBus`). When `notifications_reason_id` remains `nil` (such as on records created by `UserNotifications#send_notification_email`), `TopicUser.update_last_read` and `TopicUser.auto_track` will treat the notification level as never explicitly set by the user and automatically switch the user back to `tracking` when they view or interact with the topic.

findings.title: State-mutating `GET` endpoint is non-idempotent on reload and skipped on client-side transitions
findings.body:
`TopicsController#unsubscribe` mutates `notification_level` directly inside a `GET` request and branches on the current level (`> regular` becomes `regular`, otherwise `muted`). If the user refreshes the page, clicks the link twice, or has an email client/scanner prefetch the URL, the second `GET` will downgrade the topic from `regular` to `muted` (or overwrite a level the user just chose in the page's dropdown).

Conversely, if a user is logged out when clicking the link in their email, `ensure_logged_in` redirects them to `/login`. Once they log in and Ember routes client-side to `/t/:slug/:id/unsubscribe`, `TopicUnsubscribeRoute#model` (`app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/topic-unsubscribe.js.es6` line 6) calls `PostStream.loadTopicView(params.id)`, which requests `GET /t/:id.json` (`TopicsController#show`) rather than `TopicsController#unsubscribe`. In that flow, the unsubscribe action never runs on the server, the notification level remains unchanged, and the page falsely informs the user that notifications have been stopped.

findings.title: `MessageBuilder` raises `I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument` if `add_unsubscribe_link` is set without `unsubscribe_url`
findings.body: `config/locales/server.en.yml` updates `unsubscribe_link` to require `%{unsubscribe_url}`, and `MessageBuilder#html_part` (line 67) and `MessageBuilder#body` (line 90) evaluate `I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args)` whenever `@opts[:add_unsubscribe_link]` is true. However, `MessageBuilder#initialize` only populates a default for `:user_preferences_url` in `@template_args`, not `:unsubscribe_url`. Any caller that passes `add_unsubscribe_link: true` without also passing `unsubscribe_url` will raise `I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument`.

findings.title: Missing specs for `TopicsController#unsubscribe`
findings.body: There are no controller specs covering `TopicsController#unsubscribe` (such as transitioning from watching/tracking to regular, transitioning from regular to muted, handling a user without an existing `TopicUser` row, or redirecting when the slug does not match).
